# Terminal Bench Harbor Runner

Use `/opt/miniconda3/envs/terminal-bench/bin/harbor` as the Harbor CLI. Do not assume the system `harbor` on PATH is the right one.

## Quick Workflow

1. Verify Harbor:

```bash
/opt/miniconda3/envs/terminal-bench/bin/harbor --version
```

2. For oracle runs, use the script without model credentials:

```bash
/Users/hugo/.codex/skills/terminal-bench-harbor-runner/scripts/run_terminal_bench_harbor.sh \
  --task harbor/tasks/arcade-case-miner \
  --agent oracle \
  --job-name arcade-case-miner-oracle
```

3. For Claude Code, prefer the Token Plan endpoint. The runner sources `~/.bashrc` and maps `TOKEN_PLAN_BASE_URL` / `TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` into Claude Code's `ANTHROPIC_*` variables. Never write API keys into repo files or skill files.

```bash
export TOKEN_PLAN_BASE_URL='https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic'
export TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY=[REDACTED]'

/Users/hugo/.codex/skills/terminal-bench-harbor-runner/scripts/run_terminal_bench_harbor.sh \
  --task harbor/tasks/arcade-case-miner \
  --agent claude-code \
  --model kimi-k2.6 \
  --job-name arcade-case-miner-claude-code-kimi \
  --work-copy \
  --allow-internet \
  --setup-timeout 1200 \
  --agent-timeout 1200 \
  --log-file harbor/runs/arcade-case-miner-claude-code-kimi/runner.log
```

4. On this machine, direct no-proxy network has resolved some hosts to `198.18.*` and caused `ECONNRESET`. If direct mode fails in setup or API calls, use the container proxy variant:

```bash

  --task harbor/tasks/arcade-case-miner \
```

tasks on the local SSD with Claude Code, especially for `kimi-k2.5`, `kimi-k2.6`,
or another Anthropic-compatible model.



Full Kimi K2.5 batch template:

```bash
cd /Users/hugo/Desktop/super-refactor
source ~/.bashrc >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///Users/hugo/.colima/tb21-harbor/docker.sock
export HARBOR_CLAUDE_CODE_BINARY=/Users/hugo/Desktop/super-refactor/harbor/cache/claude-code/claude-linux-arm64
export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1

  --run-name tb21-kimi-k25-local-019e737a-ssd-proxy \
  --model kimi-k2.5 \
  --min-concurrency 2 \
  --max-concurrency 4 \
  --max-task-memory-mb 16384 \
  --low-disk-gb 35 \
  --prune-cache-below-gb 45 \
  --harbor-retries 1 \
  --include-verifier-metadata
```

The script name contains `k26` for historical reasons; it is model-agnostic
when `--model` is passed. Increase `--max-concurrency` toward 8 only if memory,
Docker, and SSD pressure are stable. For other Anthropic-compatible models,
export their `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, and model name before
launching, then set `--model` to the exact provider model id.

The batch runner should preserve traces and live container artifacts before
cleanup. Its default container copy paths should include:

```text
/logs, /app, /workspace, /tests
```

If using an older runner, pass them explicitly with repeated
`--container-copy-path` flags. `/workspace` matters for tasks such as
`prove-plus-comm`.

For detached runs, put the command above in a run-local launch script and start
it with `screen`, e.g. `screen -dmS tb21-kimi-k25-ssd bash <launch-script>`.
Keep API keys in `~/.bashrc`, Keychain, or the environment; never write keys into
repo files, skill files, run manifests, or chat output.

Completion is not just "the process exited". Audit all of these:

- `state.json` has 89 rows and no missing task names.
- Every task has at least one nonempty trace export or raw fallback JSONL.
- Every task's final container artifacts are covered by the main run or a
  supplemental artifact run.
- Each covered container has `inspect.sanitized.json`, `docker-diff.txt`, copied
  `/logs`, copied `/tests`, and copied code directory (`/app` or Dockerfile
  `WORKDIR`, commonly `/workspace`).
- Docker has no active task containers and no `hb__*` task images after cleanup.
- `screen -ls` and process checks show no stale Harbor runner/watchdog unless a
  monitor is intentionally active.

If traces are complete but container artifacts have gaps, run a supplemental
artifact pass with `--force-rerun`, a small task list, and low concurrency
(`--min-concurrency 1 --max-concurrency 1` or 2). Preserve existing run data;
do not delete prior traces. After the supplemental pass, audit coverage across
all relevant run roots.

Autotune’s best score so far is 0.6017, below the manual subword model. I’ll wait for it to complete, but the evidence still favors the manual `wordNgrams=2` plus character n-grams recipe.

steps.text:
Done. `/app/model.bin` exists in the container and is under the size limit.

What changed:
- Installed the Debian `fasttext` CLI in the container.
- Converted the Yelp parquet data to FastText supervised format for training/validation.
- Trained a supervised FastText classifier with word trigrams and character n-grams.
- Quantized the best model and saved it as `/app/model.bin`.
- Removed temporary training/model files; `/app` now contains `data/` and `model.bin`.

Validation:
- Public validation file: `data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet`, 10,000 examples.
- Final model accuracy: `P@1 = 0.628`.
- Final size: `124,531,872` bytes, about `119 MiB`, under 150 MB.
- Verified the renamed quantized file loads with `fasttext test /app/model.bin ...`.
